newsitem.title: USA: U-Ship says director Vogen replaces CEO.
newsitem.headline: U-Ship says director Vogen replaces CEO.

text.p: U-Ship Inc said the board authorized a management restructuring in which Richard Vogen, a director, was named chairman and chief executive.

Vogen replaces Bruce Senske, who had been president and chief executive since 1992, but who has assumed the position of president and chief operating officer of U-Ship's new Automated Shipping Centers Division.

"The automated shipping systems division under Mr. Senske will concentrate on the areas of marketing the company's ASC technology, licenses and strategic relationships. At the same time, the company intends to develop new technologies and seek opportunities to acquire new technologies, additional product lines or businesses," the company said.

Vogen said, "The management redeployment will be accompanied by some cut-backs in personnel and reduction in overhead related to the ASC division, but we believe that this is warranted to conserve its capital and to more prudently deploy assets."
U-Ship makes self-service, automated shipping systems which it places in locations such as copy centers, office supply stores and retail service counters.
